thread:
Sofia: Morning — GA landed a handful of regressions + a few small enhancement asks. Need a 25m rapid on whether to hotpatch or bake into the next minor.
Randy: +1. Suggest we use a tiny decision matrix: Severity (P0/P1/P2), Customer count, Effort (S/M/L). Only P0s or P1s hitting >=2 paying customers go to hotpatch.
Lina: I'll pull customer tickets and map orgs. Putting a hard rule: model-weight changes or retrains are NOT hotpatch material.
Marco: Dev note: anything touching routing or runtime flags needs a rollback toggle. No toggle => not in minor.
tracker-bot: Telemetry snapshot: 11 release-tagged errors. Top signals: auth-502 (87), stream-stall (34), embed-order (7). Link: https://redwood-internal/reports/1965433123
Sofia: Cool. I'll run the quick sweep. Randy, can you heat-rank by unique-users impacted?
Randy: Running:

```bash
sentry-cli search "tag:release AND tag:postlaunch" --fields=count,users --limit=20
```

Randy: Will post numbers in ~45m.
Lina: Owner picks: I'll take auth-502 and the two customer tickets tied to it. Marco can take stream-stall with infra pairing.
Marco: Starting infra traces for stream-stall. If it's a config param we can patch same-day; if it's model latency, schedule for next minor.
Sofia: Decision anchors here:
- P0 (data loss/SLA) -> hotpatch
- P1 + >=2 paying customers -> hotpatch candidate (confirm low-risk)
- P1 single-customer or P2 -> next minor/backlog
- Model retrain or ML infra -> investigate -> next minor
Sofia: Action items:
- Randy: attach heatlist + user counts (45m)
- Lina: triage auth-502 + size (EOD)
- Marco: RCA for stream-stall + size (3h)
- Sofia: run 25m sync in #product-ops at :45 to finalize
Lina: Adding labels in tracker: patch-bucket, next-minor, customer-pledge, risk-ticketing.
Randy: Early data: auth-502 spike correlates with a proxy retry loop; affects 3 enterprise orgs repeatedly. marking high-priority.
Marco: Update: stream-stall shows a small backpressure loop in runtime config; likely S fix. If confirmed, we can patch via canary same-day.
Sofia: Good. If auth-502 PR passes canary, cut a hotpatch. If stream-stall is config-only, do a canary-first patch. Otherwise schedule stream work for next minor.
Lina: I'll prepare comms for the three impacted customers in case we hotpatch.
Sofia: Thanks team — quick sync at :45 to close owners. If you can't make it, drop a note here and put sizes in the tracker.
